criteria.statement: DNS/operator UI exposes a FIPS/Mesh tab alongside zones, endpoints, drift, and policies.
The FIPS/Mesh tab is backed by fips-mesh.svelte.js Nostr read-model state and does not introduce FIPS REST fetch endpoints or polling loops.
Operators can see mesh worker identity, overlay address, transport endpoints, health metrics, DNS/FIPS hostnames, projection status, and gating reason when available.
Operators can filter mesh nodes by health, worker, capability, and projection state.
The panel has useful unavailable, disabled, empty, and tombstone/removal reflected states.
